LESSON: LOVE

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Values
Topic 4.4: Love

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Love. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How did Jesus Christ show love to children?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15
2. demonstrate love by showing kindness to others
3. appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: LOVE
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Love helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: LOVE
Study Love like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15

What this means
In this part you learn to recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Love” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Demonstrate love by showing kindness to others

What this means
In this part you learn to demonstrate love by showing kindness to others. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: demonstrate love by showing kindness to others.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Love in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can demonstrate love by showing kindness to others. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Love is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Love” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Love in your own words. (skill: demonstrate love by showing kindness to others)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Love to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15.
3. Practise this skill: demonstrate love by showing kindness to others.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Love from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Love: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Love?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did Jesus Christ show love to children?
2. How do you show Godly love to others as a Christian?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Love means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15.
5. Be able to: demonstrate love by showing kindness to others.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
